base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y git curl libpng-dev libjpeg62-turbo-dev libfreetype-dev libzip-dev
docker-php-ext-install gd zip mbstring xml dom simplexml fileinfo ctype iconv xmlreader xmlwriter

runtime_profile.notes: PHP 8.2 CLI base image with Composer installed. All required extensions for PHPSpreadsheet are installed via docker-php-ext-install. No virtual environment needed as PHP uses system-level installation.

notes: Base image: mirror.gcr.io/library/php:8.2-cli (mirror of docker.io/library/php:8.2-cli to avoid Docker Hub rate limiting). git and curl are installed via apt-get in base_setup_commands. Apt sources are explicitly pinned to Debian bookworm repositories to avoid conflicts with trixie/testing packages. Package names updated for bookworm compatibility: libfreetype-dev (instead of libfreetype6-dev) and libjpeg62-turbo-dev (instead of libjpeg-dev). Composer is installed from getcomposer.org. The project requires PHP 8.0+ and specific extensions which are installed using docker-php-ext-install. This approach uses the official PHP Docker image which provides the docker-php-ext-* scripts for easy extension installation.
